INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS','EDS','EDS','TRU_TRUPRODUCTS','TRU',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL;GO
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS','EDS_STG','D360','TRU_TRUPRODUCTS','TRU',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL;GO

INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS','TSK_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS',NULL; GO
